format: html

**Load Your Packages**

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

**Read in Your Data**

```{r}
Height_Data_Raw <- 
  read_excel("Oak Data Entry MCRS Field Trip.xlsx", 
             sheet = "Seedling Heights")

Moist_Data_Raw <- 
  read_excel("Oak Data Entry MCRS Field Trip.xlsx", 
             sheet = "Soil Moisture")

SPAD_Data_Raw <- 
  read_excel("Oak Data Entry MCRS Field Trip.xlsx", 
             sheet = "SPAD", 
             na = "NA")
```

**Data Cleaning for Anova Dataset**

```{r}
Soil_Moisture_Data <- Moist_Data_Raw |> 
  #Grab only necessary columns for simplicity
  select(Block, Treatment, VWC1_perc, VWC2_perc, VWC3_perc) |> 
  #Make sure data columns are in numberic format
  mutate(
    VWC1_perc = as.numeric(VWC1_perc),
    VWC2_perc = as.numeric(VWC2_perc),
    VWC3_perc = as.numeric(VWC3_perc),
    Soil_Moisture_Mean = (VWC1_perc + VWC2_perc + VWC3_perc) / 3
  ) |> 
  #Removes rows with NA values which aren't relevant to the data
  drop_na(Treatment, Soil_Moisture_Mean) |> 
  
  #Filters out single NR treatment measurement row
  filter(Treatment != "NR") |> 
  
  #Converts treatment to factor type for ANOVA
  mutate(Treatment = as.factor(Treatment))
```

**Data Cleaning for Regression Dataset**

```{r}
Height_Data <- Height_Data_Raw |> 
  mutate(Seedling_Ht_cm = as.numeric(Seedling_Ht_cm)) |> 
  #Filter out dead seedlings
  filter(Dead_Alive == "Alive") |> 
  
  #Filter out SA and NR treatments
  filter(Treatment != "SA") |> 
  filter(Treatment != "NR") |> 
  
  #Convert open space treatment rows labelled "OA" to their correct notation
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      Treatment == "OA" ~ "OS",
      TRUE ~ Treatment
    ),
    Treatment = as.factor(Treatment),
    Dead_Alive = as.factor(Dead_Alive),
    Seedling_Ht_cm = as.numeric(Seedling_Ht_cm)
  ) |> 
  #Remove any rows with NA values in their columns instead of actual data
  drop_na(Seedling_Ht_cm)


Regression_Data <- Soil_Moisture_Data |> 
  #Join moisture data and height data together by block and treatment
  inner_join(Height_Data, by = c("Block", "Treatment")) |> 
  select(Block, Treatment, Tag_Num, Soil_Moisture_Mean, Seedling_Ht_cm) |> 
  #Extra check for any more rows without data values
  drop_na(Soil_Moisture_Mean, Seedling_Ht_cm)

#Dataset showing the counts of alive and dead seedlings for each treatment
Establishment_Data <- Height_Data_Raw |> 
  filter(Treatment != "SA") |> 
  filter(Treatment != "NR") |> 
  mutate(
    Treatment = case_when(
      Treatment == "OA" ~ "OS",
      TRUE ~ Treatment
    ),
    #Converts treatment and seedling life status into categorical variable types for models
    Treatment = as.factor(Treatment),
    Dead_Alive = as.factor(Dead_Alive),
    
    #Ensures seedling heights are in proper numeric form
    Seedling_Ht_cm = as.numeric(Seedling_Ht_cm)
  ) |> 
  drop_na(Treatment, Dead_Alive) |> 
  group_by(Treatment, Dead_Alive) |> 
  
  #Summarizes the count of alive/dead seedlings for each treatment
  summarize(count = n(), .groups = "drop")
Establishment_Data

Soil_Moisture_Data |> 
  count(Treatment)
```

\
**Summary Table**

```{r}
summary_table <- Regression_Data |> 
  group_by(Treatment) |> #organized by treatment
  summarise( #Calculate summary statistics for soil moisture and seedling height
    Sample_Size      = n(),
    Mean_Soil_Moist  = mean(Soil_Moisture_Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Soil_Moist    = sd(Soil_Moisture_Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE_Soil_Moist    = sd(Soil_Moisture_Mean, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    
    Mean_Seedling_Ht = mean(Seedling_Ht_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Seedling_Ht   = sd(Seedling_Ht_cm, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE_Seedling_Ht   = sd(Seedling_Ht_cm, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  )

# Display the summary table
summary_table
```

**ANOVA Analysis**

```{r}
#This code creates a linear model for analysis
soil_model = lm(Soil_Moisture_Mean ~ Treatment + factor(Block), data = Soil_Moisture_Data)


# Normality of Residuals
plot(soil_model, which = 2) # Q-Q Plot
shapiro.test(soil_model$residuals) # Shapiro-Wilk test

# Bartlett Test of Homogeneity of Variances
bartlett.test(Soil_Moisture_Mean ~ Treatment, data = Soil_Moisture_Data)
```

```{r}
# ANOVA Statistical Test (with Treatment and Blocking)
soil_anova <- aov(Soil_Moisture_Mean ~ Treatment + factor(Block), data = Soil_Moisture_Data)
summary(soil_anova)
```

```{r}
#Nice Graph
#Graphs 1 and 2: Boxplots of soil moisture by habitat treatment
ggplot(Soil_Moisture_Data, aes(x = Treatment, y = Soil_Moisture_Mean, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, color = "black") +
  labs(
    title = "Soil Moisture Across Habitat Treatments",
    x = "Habitat Treatment",
    y = "Mean Volumetric Water Content (%)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplot(Soil_Moisture_Data, aes(x = Treatment, y = Soil_Moisture_Mean, fill = Treatment)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  labs(
    title = "Soil Moisture Across Habitat Treatments",
    x = "Habitat Treatment",
    y = "Mean Volumetric Water Content (%)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

#Graph 3: Soil moisture by block, check if spatial gradient is present
ggplot(Soil_Moisture_Data, aes(x = factor(Block), y = Soil_Moisture_Mean, fill = factor(Block))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "Soil Moisture Variation Across Sampling Blocks",
    x = "Block Number",
    y = "Mean Soil Moisture (VWC %)"
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

**Regression Analysis**

```{r}

# Create linear model
height_reg <- lm(Seedling_Ht_cm ~ Soil_Moisture_Mean, data = Regression_Data)

#Check linear regression assumptions, Residuals vs Fitted plot
plot(height_reg, which = 1)

# Normality of Residuals (Q-Q Plot and Shapiro-Wilk Test)
plot(height_reg, which = 2)
shapiro.test(residuals(height_reg))


```

```{r}
# Summary of linear model output (slope, intercept, R squared, and p value)
summary(height_reg)

```

```{r}
#Mean Soil Moisture vs Seedling Height
ggplot(Regression_Data, aes(x = Soil_Moisture_Mean, y = Seedling_Ht_cm)) +
  geom_point(color = "black", size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    title = "Oak Seedling Height vs. Soil Moisture",
    x = "Mean Soil Moisture (VWC %)",
    y = "Seedling Height (cm)"
  )

ggplot(Height_Data, aes(x = Treatment, y = Seedling_Ht_cm, fill = Treatment)) +
  # Add boxplots to show distribution and median
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
  # Add individual raw data points with jitter for transparency
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1.5, color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Oak Seedling Height Across Habitat Treatments",
    x = "Habitat Treatment",
    y = "Seedling Height (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Bar chart of oak seedling establishment (survival vs. mortality) by treatment
ggplot(Establishment_Data, aes(x = Treatment, y = count, fill = Dead_Alive)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Alive" = "lightgreen", "Dead" = "darkred"),
    name = "Status"
    
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Oak Seedling Establishment by Habitat Treatment",
    subtitle = "Counts of surviving (Alive) vs. non-surviving (Dead) seedlings",
    x = "Habitat Treatment",
    y = "Number of Seedlings"
  )
```
